svg.text: 3D CAD Model 1 (PRIMARY): True Kit Navigator 300 + Split STOL Flaperons
Bow-contoured Hard Deck & Under-Hull Hybrid C-Frame • Internal pod servos (0 deck boxes) • 400 mm deep ocean-safe foil
Follows bow rocker & curve • ZERO boxes above deck!
Ties bow ski-nose to D-ring • Zero hull holes!
Only 9 mm blades pierce chop (~4 lbf, 0 wave slam)
Ahead of 26 L bay + internal IP67 flaperon servos
Interactive 3D STL: models/01_navigator300_stol_flaperons.stl (click on GitHub to orbit/zoom or 3D-print at 1:15 scale)
